items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: Tuva? Tuva. That big thing. The tuva. That's what he played. It was an all brass band that he launched in.

ctx.x: Tuva? Tuva. That big thing. The tuva. That's what he played. It was an all brass band that he launched in. That's no string instrument at all. And I remember they played it at his funeral. His members stayed at his funeral in Dallas. And that was history at that time. Oh, everybody. All the bands played. But you've been around there. Then you've got some history of the can of them. Because they were all out. All out. Yeah.
I've heard of that brass band in my back. Now, now.
